title: Q1
description:
“Not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works and of faith toward God, of the doctrine of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.”
Read: Lev 16:4, 21, Num 8:10, Dan 12:2
a) Washings, laying on of hands, resurrection and judgment all have OT roots. What does that background bring forward about why these are *foundation*, to be built on rather than laid again?
